system: MASTER RIG - one skeleton/system, many drawing sets
rule: One skeleton/system: joints shoulder/elbow/wrist, hip/knee/ankle, spine pelvis->torso->head, cape. Rules shared across views: pivot = ball centre or saved pivot_xy, wrist = wrist end of forearm, knee-feet = knees and feet same direction, no-crop gate, whole pieces only (no square/rectangular crop of a piece), RIG-00 never edited in place. What changes per view is the DRAWING SET + layer order + pivots, switched as a group. Never warp, squash, or mirror one view's art into another view. Front art is never a back rig.
